originalTitle: Market wrap: Titan Company, Bajaj Finance, SBI among top gainers and losers on Nifty and Sensex on Monday
simplifiedContent: The Indian stock market was mostly unchanged on Monday. This was because good news from the US about jobs was balanced by bad news about rising oil prices and problems in the Middle East. Some companies, like Titan Company, Tata Consumer, and Bajaj Finance, did well and their stock prices went up. On the other hand, SBI's stock price went down the most. This means that if you invested in these companies, your money might have gone up or down depending on which company you chose.

originalTitle: Indian bonds steady as soft US data offsets oil rise
simplifiedContent: The value of Indian government bonds didn't change much on Monday. This happened because some economic data from the US was weaker than expected, which might mean that the US will lower its interest rates, and that's good for bonds. However, the price of oil went up, which could be bad for bonds, so these two things balanced each other out. The interest rate on a specific Indian government bond, the 6.94% 2036 bond, actually went down a little to 6.7594%. Investors are now waiting to see what happens with inflation data in India and the US to get a better idea of what might happen with interest rates next.

originalTitle: Project Sudarsan: How Sebi is using AI to police finfluencers with 60% of investors trusting their advice
simplifiedContent: The Indian stock market regulator, Sebi, is using artificial intelligence (AI) to keep an eye on fake or misleading financial advice on social media. This is important because many investors, about 62%, trust the advice they get from finfluencers (influencers who give financial advice). Sebi has a project called Sudarsan that tracks unwanted advice, and another system that reviews advertisements to make sure they are honest. Sebi is doing this to protect investors from being misled. By using AI, Sebi can better supervise what's being said online and help keep investors safe.

originalTitle: Penny stock under  ₹10 to be in focus on Tuesday; here's why
simplifiedContent: A small company called A-1 Limited is expected to be in the news on Tuesday because it just received a big order. The order is from a company called Solar Group and is worth ₹38.70 crore, which is a significant amount. A-1 Limited will supply acids and industrial chemicals to Solar Group and has to complete the order by October 31, 2026. This is good news for A-1 Limited because it means the company will have a steady source of income, which can help its business grow. This order is important because it shows that A-1 Limited is a reliable partner in the chemical supply chain in India.

originalTitle: Gland Pharma Q1 Results: Net profit jumps 47% YoY to  ₹317 crore; CDMO revenue rises 20%
simplifiedContent: Gland Pharma, a company that makes and sells medicines, just released its financial results for the first quarter of the year. The company made a profit of ₹317 crore, which is 47% more than it made during the same time last year. Its total revenue, or the amount of money it made from sales, was ₹1,800 crore, a 20% increase from last year, thanks to its contract manufacturing and business-to-business sales, especially in the US and Europe. This is a significant increase, which could be good news for people who have invested in the company. The company's profit decreased slightly from the previous quarter, but overall, its yearly performance is strong.

originalTitle: Top Gainers & Losers on 10 August: Hitachi Energy, Paytm, Titian, BSE, BEML, Lenskart among top gainers
simplifiedContent: On August 10, the Indian stock market didn't change much, with some stocks going up and others going down. The main stock market indexes, Nifty 50 and Sensex, had small changes, with Nifty 50 going up a little and Sensex going down a little. This happened while there were worries about a conflict in the Middle East that was affecting oil prices. Some groups of stocks, like those related to real estate and private banks, did well, but others didn't. Overall, it was a relatively calm day for the stock market, with no big changes.
